policy: Ask at most three relevant unanswered questions per turn. now means relevant to this pilot, not universal onboarding. Do not collect real IDs, dates of birth or full addresses initially. A conditional question requires a cited applicable condition, not just a retrieved keyword.

questions.question: Describe the deliverables and any sales, printing, advertising or regulated professional work.
What legal form is recorded, and is incorporation complete or only planned?
questions.reason: Do not route incorporation as first licensing.

questions.question: Are you the owner, manager or representative for this request?
Is the owner a person or an organisation?
Which nationality category applies to the owner?
questions.reason: No civil ID or passport is needed for routing.

questions.question: Does the owner have the residency status required by the verified route?
questions.reason: Ask status, not an identity document.

questions.question: Has MOCI confirmed an activity code for these deliverables?
questions.reason: Never infer the code from the business name.

questions.question: What type of premises is proposed?
questions.reason: Do not assume home, micro-business or professional routes.

questions.question: Intake says Unit 21 and the synthetic lease scenario says Unit 12. Which is correct?
questions.reason: Keep both evidence locations and founder correction.

questions.question: Do you meet the verified age condition, if one applies?
questions.reason: Use eligibility answer or age band before exact birth date.

questions.question: Does an applicable employment restriction affect the relevant owner or manager?
questions.reason: Do not assume founder and manager are the same person.

questions.question: Who would review the draft and act as authorised applicant?
questions.reason: A source can identify requirements but cannot authorise an action.

questions.question: Which current official fee schedule covers the confirmed route?
questions.reason: Unknown fees stay null; estimates remain labelled.
